answer: Require every agent to post a refundable bond before joining the shared reputation graph, so each vertex is one bonded identity, not a free account. Endorsements act as a public signal weighted by the endorser's own stake and service history, never by raw vote count. New agents begin in a shallow lagoon of low-value tasks and earn higher-value work only after sustained verifiable service, so creating thousands of fake identities means funding thousands of bonds and doing real work for each, costing more than any fraud could gain.
